description: Reschedule, update copy/threadPosts/firstComment/images/PDF documentUrl/videoUrl/destination page, clear images, cancel, or immediately publish an existing scheduled post while keeping the underlying campaign asset in sync.

clearImages.description: Set true to clear attached images on this scheduled post

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image files from ChatGPT to attach to this scheduled post

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into PNGs and attach

threadPosts.description: Optional updated multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon

userConfirmedLivePublish.description: Set true ONLY after explicit user confirmation in chat when action is "publish_now" on a Confirm in Chat channel

name: wordflux_manage_scheduled_post
